# YYYY-MM-DD: Session title

## Objective

What outcome did the session pursue, and what was explicitly out of scope?

## Starting context

Record the relevant research program, hypothesis or experiment IDs, branch, repository state, and
assumptions needed to understand the work.

## Decisions

- Decision, rationale, and important alternatives not chosen.

## Work completed

- Durable documents, code, data, artifacts, or commits created or changed.
- Validation performed and its result.

## Evidence and findings

Preserve the observations that matter for continuing the work. Distinguish evidence from inference
and note any stale, provisional, or unverified state.

## Open threads

- Unanswered questions, blockers, failed approaches, and risks.

## Resume here

Give the next agent a concrete first action, the files to read, and any command or environment detail
that is necessary to continue safely.

## Related records

Link the relevant idea, hypothesis, experiment, research, and artifact records. Never include secrets,
credentials, private data, or a raw transcript when a concise handoff is sufficient.
